nodes.label: docs/canon/CONTRADICTION_MAP.md — everything the user said, in date order, versus everything that contradicts it, scoped by layer so cross-layer false contradictions never appear. The live list: 4 contradicted statements, 16 tensions awaiting his judgement, 14 near-collisions scoping dissolves, 84 standing subject-lines, 5 layer-ambiguous statements

Spine sources of the map. First-hand: docs/canon/raw/user_turns_all.md / .jsonl, 920 verified turns 2026-05-14 → 2026-08-05, cited as turns:L<line> = line in the .md rendering; the map's own readings were made against the 803 turns extant on 08-03 and turns after that are in the corpus and not yet swept. Second-hand: docs/canon/raw/desktop_docs_record.md, always marked second-hand. State evidence: raw/git_record.md, DESIGN_HISTORY.md and the live tree. Agent-surface evidence: the actual file and line, quoted

The three contradiction types every entry carries: (a) the user's own later statement reverses the earlier one — both quoted, both dated; (b) what was actually built or shipped does the opposite — git ref or file:line, layer-matched; (c) an agent-written surface asserts the opposite — file and quote

Layer scoping, and v3/ is the environment, not a generation. v3/ is the harness the work happens in; living inside it are a modified v1 artefact and an abandoned native rebuild, and those are different things that must never share a tag. His words: "we are NOT doing the v3 artefact, we are doing the v1artefact, however, since only v3 is the downloaded area here … we have imported the v1arm here" (07-26, turns:L2941), and the split he draws himself: "when i say current, i mean v1artefact you can find in this, up to date repo.. when i say original v1, i mean several months ago in the old branches, the k=40 era" (07-26, turns:L2949). Every entry carries one layer tag, and a statement and its contradiction must sit in the same layer, or the statement is CROSS, for the collision to count

V1-GRAPH — baked. The herb-eval Neo4j graph as it exists: the chunking, the tag vocabulary, the facet slots, and the w_chunk / w_facets / relevance_to_file values materialised onto its nodes and HAS_TAG edges. Content was stripped and the semantic layer re-embedded with the v3 embedder in July (reembed_herb_eval.py); it was never retagged. Nothing here can be changed by editing retrieval code — a contradiction landing in V1-GRAPH requires a rebuild or a retag, and every entry that lands there says so

V1-ENGINE — live code. The modified v1 artefact: v3/pipelines/artefact_v1.py (1725 lines) and v3/pipelines/artefact_v1_det.py (262 lines) — new retrieval code written inside v3 that queries V1-GRAPH (DATABASE defaults to herb-eval, artefact_v1.py:117). Freely changeable. His July–August design statements land here, and this is the thing his 07-26 ruling names

The other three layers plus CROSS. V1-ORIGINAL — frozen: the thesis v1 build as frozen into v1/ at 0efff16 (06-15), the React/TS workbench, retrieval.ts, interpreter.ts, the k=40 era; gone from the working tree, present in git history, and its design decisions are V1-GRAPH's ancestry. V2-DESIGN: the rebuild design line from 296fc40 (05-30) — shape-probe, resolver, the June facet redesigns; design only, never a running arm. V3-NATIVE: the native rebuild in v3/artefact/ (28c95aa, 06-24), run 06-28, condemned by the user 07-01, never adopted — not "v3". CROSS: statements about the project as a whole — overfitting, arbitrary numbers, evaluation method, canon provenance, how agents work — contradictable from any layer

What fixing a surviving collision requires — the layer decides the remedy and the remedies are not interchangeable: engine change (editable code in v3/pipelines/artefact_v1*.py); graph rebuild/retag (re-tagging or rebuilding herb-eval, which no retrieval-code edit reaches); doc correction (a surface asserts the wrong thing, the line is deleted or replaced); user ruling (nobody can close it without him). Statements that cannot be placed between V1-GRAPH and V1-ENGINE from their wording are tagged [V1-GRAPH? / V1-ENGINE?], carry the test that would settle them, and are collected in Part 5

The map's summary counts: ≈137 first-hand spine statements considered (of the 803 turns extant at the 08-03 pass) and ≈95 second-hand; 4 contradicted statements in Part 1, by layer CROSS 2 · V1-ENGINE 2, with 0 carrying a type-(a) self-reversal, 4 carrying type-(b) built-state evidence and 2 carrying type-(c) agent-surface claims; 14 possible tensions in Part 2 (V1-ENGINE 5 · CROSS 4 · V1-GRAPH 5); 14 cross-layer near-collisions dissolved by scoping in Part 3; 84 standing subject-lines in Part 4; 5 layer-ambiguous statements in Part 5. Surviving collisions by remedy: engine change 3 (entries 1, 2, 4) · doc correction 1 (entry 3) · user ruling 0 · graph rebuild/retag 0

No contradicted statement in Part 1 is trapped in the baked graph. The three problems that are baked — oracle residue, which facet set is real, and the slug-polluted tag vocabulary — sit in Part 2 as T3, T9 and T15, where they are tensions awaiting his judgement rather than contradictions, and where the only available remedy is a rebuild nobody has proposed. T15 is the one he found himself, on 08-02, and it is what the canon-mining order came out of 80 minutes later

Part 1 entry 1 · 2026-06-30 · [CROSS] — "by NOT overfitting it to the specific dataset we have" (turns:L340), restated 07-15 (turns:L721) and 07-22 (turns:L2320). The charge is access: the agent had the ground truth available and started fitting to it. (b) What was tuned against gold-100 is entirely engine-side — the July experiment chain selected engine mechanisms by gold-100 recall_id (detPOOLCUT/detCURVEK/detADMIT, turns:L3424-3437) and the August sweeps (WTAG0/2/4, TAGINFORM, WG_GUIDE) selected combine weights and modifier strengths on that same gold-100. His 08-02 verdict names it: "not only did i mean you are forcing an architecture BASED on retrieving the gold based on the questions, it also feels like you are focusing on it" (turns:L4269). Layer & fix: engine change on a user ruling about which swept values may stand

Two bounds on the overfitting charge. V1-GRAPH is not exposed: the graph was tagged and weighted before gold-100 existed and has never been retagged, so no baked value was fitted to the eval set, and the exposure is exactly the set of engine tunables — which also means it is fully removable. And no swept value reached a default: across the 23 numeric tunables and flags of artefact_v1.py — W_TAG / W_DESC / W_SCOPE, the STR_* family, K_LEVELS, the GUIDE_* family, TAG_ADMIT, AGG, NORM, NORM_SCOPE, KNN_OVERFETCH, CURVE_WALK, TAG_FIRST, WALK_GATE — `git log -p --follow` shows no assignment line ever removed or modified, so the sweeps are evidence about those values, not evidence for them. Model ids are outside this claim. The access is cut 2026-08-04 by the gold-blindness hard rule

Part 1 entry 2 · 2026-07-15 · [V1-ENGINE] — "i do NOT like arbitrary choices for k or any number or value, fucking BASE it on something, i kinda like knn clustering for relevance spheres for example for grounding, k, retrival etc etc" (turns:L779). Same day on the arm as found: "2. 10? fucking why just 10? … Honestly, no fucking wonder we get shit results, this is an abomination" (turns:L729-733); restated 07-21 (turns:L1984) and 08-02 (turns:L4217). (b) The arm that ships is built on unbased constants, all in engine code: K_LEVELS = (8, 16, 32, 64) (artefact_v1.py:129), GUIDE_TAU default 0.01 (:234), POOL_FETCH=256 / POOL_MIN, and the value system the 07-22 adversarial panel condemned as an ordinal staircase with 12:5:1 door bias plus prescription. The 64 he flagged on 08-02 is K_LEVELS[-1]. A borrowed constant killed one experiment outright: TAG_MIN_SIM=0.78 ported from V1-ORIGINAL

Part 1 entry 2, the other direction and his ruling. The one number he demanded be based on something — per-query K from his cluster concept — exists but is off in the shipped default: the clustering decides K only under HERB_CURVE_WALK (artefact_v1.py:136-141) and the per-facet cluster guide only at HERB_STR_GUIDE > 0 (:225-233, default 0.0), so a default run takes the caller's flat k, and in the flat regime the tag pool is clustered and the level chain built per part per question then discarded unopened. His ruling 2026-08-05: K comes from the clustering — "yes, i do want the k, not the made up bullshit". Per-query K derived from his clustering belongs on the load-bearing path; K_LEVELS as the value model and budget does not. It does not settle R3, and it does not adopt the existing curve-walk implementation, whose stop rule _gap_break is a two-sigma spacing test whose threshold, three-gap warmup and noise floor are all unknown and which the 07-22 panel measured as carrying almost no order information (shuffled gaps produce 60.1±4.1 stops against 67 real)

Part 1 entry 3 · 2026-07-26 · [CROSS] — the most consequential collision: "yeah but no matter what we do, the issue is k=50 does not mean the same for all arms, and thats retarded.. how did the true v1 runs measure it?" (turns:L2901). The unit mismatch was already measured 07-12 — artefact k=50 mean 167,785 retrieved chars / 309.7 context ids vs vector 23,233 / 50.0 — and the identical-k design was originally his own (06-25, second-hand). (c) The auto-loading memory index headlined the unmatched-unit numbers as the finding after the ruling; those entries are deleted, the index carries no run number, and every number sits in v3/output/DATA_README.md under the unmatched-unit rule. (b) The evidence-cap / matched-token-budget work existed only inside the thread he ordered fully reverted on 07-28 and did not survive. Layer & fix: doc correction, done; T10 closed 2026-08-05

Part 1 entry 4 · 2026-08-01 · [V1-ENGINE] — "ITS NT SUPPOSED TO BE FUCKING TAG REACHABLE ffs.. tags are supposed to INFORM/weight the chunks" (turns:L4098). Lineage: the no-gates ruling of 07-15 ("gate? wtf? why have a gate? … hard filter seems insane, much better to use rankings", turns:L729) and "the whole fucking point of the tags, is guiding to the correct gold-bearing chunks" (07-30, turns:L3953, said twice L3961). (b) What shipped that same day in 6730d13 ("tags-first retrieval regime") is a tag-reachability gate, with TAG_ADMIT defaulting to exactly 0.0 so on a HERB_TAG_FIRST=1 run the admit coefficient annihilates unreached chunks rather than penalising them. His ruling 2026-08-04: the gate goes — tags route and weight, they never exclude. Layer & fix: engine change, queued — delete HERB_TAG_FIRST and HERB_TAG_ADMIT and the gated branch at artefact_v1.py:1494-1503

Part 2 T1+T2 · the k sweeps were run as truncations, and only two arms got a valid one. 06-27: "so not 5,10,15,20,30,40 ?" → "i want to do the non-llm metrics, for those k i just wrote" (turns:L221-225); 07-20: "the k50 runs you know, do all 3 as k=25 also, now, doit (not as an iverwrite, as fresh runs)" (turns:L1654). What was produced: lucene and vector at k = 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50 — every depth he named — but as re-slices of the k=50 runs, not fresh runs at each depth. The third arm has no valid curve at all: the artefact k=50 run carries no meta.chunk_ids, so truncating it discards each chunk's own ids and measures a truncated id list — its __k25 slice read 0.1309 against the parent's 0.6363 for that reason alone. The only sound artefact depth curve is on 10smoke (n=10). Fix: an engine/harness change, cheap, retrieval-only [V1-ENGINE ↔ CROSS]

Part 2 T3 · oracle residue in the baked graph [V1-GRAPH ↔ CROSS]. His quarantine canon is absolute ("we just don't fucking include the eval part in the dataset", 06-11; "DONT INCLUDE THE FUCKING EVAL FILES FOR THE PROBE TO EVER SENSE", 06-14) and is V2-DESIGN canon written for the corpus V2 was going to derive. The graph every reported artefact number comes from is V1-GRAPH, which graph_store.py's own docstring calls the superseded, oracle-contaminated v1 build; he himself was unsure 08-02: "this is not the db we did the 'purge' on, right?" (turns:L4302). The 07-28 audit split the exposure three ways: no direct answer-text leakage in any run directory; the arm resolves chunk text from full raw HERB at answer time, so quarantine rests on herb-eval locator discipline rather than on v3 code; and two soft vectors remain unverified — the tag vocabulary was partly minted by a tagger that read the oracle, and relevance_to_file is carried over from the contaminated build. The residue, if it is there, is baked: the choices are accept and declare the V1-GRAPH provenance, or stop shipping artefact numbers, and both are his

Part 2 T4, T5, T6, T7. T4 traceability demand vs provenance practice [CROSS]: 07-16 "the data about the builds ETC is important for traeability, reproducibility etc, academic purposes" (turns:L925) against "Provenance … no seed, no git-sha" recorded as a decision in the agent-written README, manifests carrying no git sha, and two load-bearing builds shipped under tooling commit titles; no record shows him deciding the no-git-sha rule. T5 hard fields as nodes [V2-DESIGN ↔ V1-GRAPH]: concept-level attributes → nodes/edges is V2-DESIGN, and the 08-02 "might as well be sql-schema" rejection is of restructuring the baked graph, so only whether the V2-DESIGN concept survives for V3-NATIVE is open. T6 thesis-done vs thesis-live rationales [CROSS]. T7 cost-blind vs cost-first [CROSS]: 06-18 "YOU do not care about cost here, 0 fucks given… only for me" against July's cost math before every claude-* run — likely different resources, but the two rules sit in the two machines' memories as opposites, unreconciled

Part 2 T9 · which facet set is real, and what it would cost to change [V1-GRAPH ↔ V2-DESIGN]. He disowned the v2 five ("assistant research synthesis… never hard-approved… it hollowed the tag", 06-25); the 06-27 recovery renames three of the four condemned v1 facets back. Surfaces assert three different settled sets: topic/entities/activity/temporal/evidence, topic/process/stance/communicative-function/time, and "topic is not a facet". The layer split answers most of it: the set actually in force is V1-GRAPH's, baked as a five-slot array on every HAS_TAG edge and read positionally — ALL_FACETS = ("topic", "entities", "activity", "temporal", "evidence") (artefact_v1.py:123) indexing r.w_facets[fi] (:372). The other two sets are V2-DESIGN and V3-NATIVE design text that never reached a graph. Changing the operative set is a retag of every edge, not a decision; what is genuinely open is only which set V3-NATIVE should be built on

Part 2 T10 · CLOSED 2026-08-05 — there is no framing decision [CROSS]. His ruling when asked which reading ships: "framing? just the fucking stats, YOU DONTY INTERPRET THE RESULTS" (08-05). The measured quantities are reported as measured, with the conditions they were measured under; no agent picks a headline, a lead sentence, or which of two descriptions of one measurement is the better story. Anything that reads as choosing what a number means is out of scope for every agent and every surface in this repo. What v3/output/DATA_README.md records, recomputed from disk: at a matched 500-id budget artefact_v1_det 0.7339 and artefact_v1 0.6363 against vector 0.4100, hybrid 0.3883, lucene 0.2742, with the paired delta, its 95% CI and W/L/T beside each; the id budget matched exactly and the character budget not; and at a common k=50 the same arms read 0.7339/0.6363 against 0.11/0.09, under the unmatched-unit rule his 07-26 ruling imposes. Both readings stand in the record as what they are

Part 2 T11, T12, T13. T11 clusters pre-computed or prompt-relative [V1-ENGINE]: 07-21 "i mean, the clusters are based on the actual shit from the prompt, so you cant pre-run it..?" (turns:L1988) vs 07-31 "i THINK it might be smartest to compute the clusters at build, and then weight-adjust them based on the query's facet-values.. i THINK, reflect on this with me" (turns:L4033) — both exploratory, neither may be treated as settled, and both options are engine-side so neither branch implies a rebuild. T12 does the no-numbers rule bind the live engine [V1-ENGINE ↔ V2-DESIGN]: V1-GRAPH's baked w_chunk / w_facets were model-emitted at V1-ORIGINAL index time and are unreachable without a retag, but V1-ENGINE's pass-2 interpreter emits facet values 0.0–1.0 at query time (artefact_v1.py:645, :774) in code written in July after the rule was posted. T13 which math combines the weights — product or sum: his ruling 2026-08-04 is that it is canonically undecided and is what the experiments are testing; neither form may be recorded as decided, in either direction

Part 2 T14 · which leg is the reported artefact configuration [V1-ENGINE]. 07-29: "i want to fucking decide which artefact that is even the baseline here, all agents keep fucking reverting to the 'det' arm, is there something in some documents that says so?" (turns:L3501) — nothing did. The det leg entered without his order; his first contact was surprise: "oh.. wait a fucking minute.. no interpreter!?" (07-25, turns:L2833). The word is settled 2026-08-04: baseline means lucene and vector, the comparison arms; artefact_v1.py and artefact_v1_det.py are two configurations of the system under test and neither is a baseline, so no measurement of either is a pass-bar. His ruling 2026-08-05, asked directly: both are reported and neither leg is named the artefact's single result. No surface may name one as the artefact number, and any figure quoted for one names its leg. The evidence behind them is not symmetric and that asymmetry is reported with them: on gold-100 the det leg leads by 0.0975, CI [−0.1382, −0.0569] paired, while every held-out and every judged number the project holds comes from the interpreting leg

Part 2 T15 · the tag layer is polluted, and it is baked [V1-GRAPH]. The herb-eval tag vocabulary carries the source's own field values as tags. Measured: 2,836 tags — 14.4% — are verbatim slugs of source field values, 1,636 of them PR titles and 1,199 URLs, at degree 1.28 against 3.81 for the rest; 2,881 — 14.6% — contain a digit; and the tightest embedding cluster in the whole tag space is n=488 at intra-cosine 0.94, a bin of github_pr_NNNN, with consecutive PR ids embedding at 0.9925. It is not spottable by eye — dynamic_table_structures is a PR title. He found it himself: "Eh.. what..we have tags with that fucking syntax? For real?" (08-02, turns:L4290, L4298). The July work stripped content and re-embedded the semantic layer, and slug-tags were never in the purge's scope; the graph has never been retagged. Any rule that reads structure out of tag-to-tag distance finds the slug bins before it finds evidence. Layer & fix: graph retag — the third baked problem beside T3 and T9

Part 2 T16 · most of the corpus never becomes a chunk, and nothing records that as a decision [V1-GRAPH]. Measured: 7 of 38 leaf positions in the HERB mapping key are declared content — 42,774 of 304,253 leaf instances, 14.1%. The other 85.9% is present in the raw files and reaches no chunk, so it is unreachable by any arm that queries the graph. Two findings bound it: the key declares 6 sections and the code reads only content and conversation — sources, directories and id_spaces are read by zero lines — and all 3 metadata files produce 0 chunks. Selecting which leaf positions carry retrievable content is a real design choice and 14.1% may be the right one; what is missing is any record that it was a choice. Every recall number is against gold citations that live in the raw files, so if a gold citation's text sits in one of the 31 undeclared leaf positions no arm can reach it and the ceiling is not what the id arithmetic says — unmeasured. Fix: graph rebuild if the declared set changes, on a user ruling

Part 3 · fourteen cross-layer near-collisions that scoping dissolves, listed explicitly so nobody re-raises them. D1 the no-numbers rule vs V1-GRAPH's model-emitted weights (baked before the rule existed; the live-code half is T12). D2 "the chunk description is dead" vs a description-driven engine (description-dead is V2-DESIGN; chunk descriptions are V1-GRAPH data by his own account). D3 content in the graph — three statements, three layers, with V1-GRAPH compliant today after the July purge. D4 HERB-only vs no-overfitting (scope-of-build vs method-generality; he holds both). D5 "before we go to the v3 construct" vs "we are NOT doing the v3 artefact" (v1 now, v3 later). D6 truncation lists ordered vs truncate_k invalid for the artefact arm (different arms). D7 lean graph, live facets vs USE ALL THE FUCKING DATA IN THE FUCKING GRAPH. D8 abstract preference vs canon-status ruling. D9 informed by the tags first vs not tag reachable (his own clarification, one day apart). D10 the user writes the real code vs the agent roster. D11 description kept tentatively vs description dead. D12 never query herb vs the arm querying herb-eval (herb ≠ herb-eval). D13 there are only 5 facets vs the June facet redesigns. D14 the three toggle flags, where WALK_GATE is built and live and the order's second clause is "only do it if it matters"

Part 4 · the standing record — 84 subject-lines with no contradiction found, one line per statement with closely-related same-day turns merged, each carrying its layer and its citation. The subjects: Quarantine & data hygiene; V1 concept (his statements about that generation); V2-DESIGN / V3-NATIVE design rulings; the modified v1 artefact — build & retrieval (July); Evaluation design; Process & agent conduct. `2h` marks a second-hand desktop_docs_record.md citation and `?` marks a layer-ambiguous statement carried in Part 5

Part 5 · five layer-ambiguous statements whose wording does not decide between the baked graph and the live engine, each carrying the test that would settle it. A1 06-27 "tag-facets inform the RELEVANCE of the tag, per facet, relative to its chunk" (turns:L285) — settled by asking whether "inform the relevance" describes a stored quantity or a query-time operation; if the operation, STR_FACET defaulting to 0.0 is a live non-compliance. A2 07-30 "the whole fucking point of the tags, is guiding to the correct gold-bearing chunks" (turns:L3953, L3961) — settled by measuring whether the baked tags can discriminate gold-bearing chunks inside a question's scope territory at all; if they cannot, it becomes a retag requirement. A3 07-29 "use the graph's shape better" (turns:L3892) — exploit structure already in V1-GRAPH, or add structure to it. A4 07-29 "kill the 90%-air problem" (turns:L3893) — a selection problem if the wasted tokens sit between retrieved chunks, a chunking problem needing a rechunk if inside them; the measurement is cheap and has never been run. A5 07-31 "compute the clusters at build" (turns:L4033) — a V1-GRAPH write or an engine-side precompute
